title: Impact of Hospital Choice on 30-Day Mortality
research_question: Does the choice of hospital, influenced by ambulance diversion, affect 30-day mortality rates for patients? Understanding the causal impact of hospital choice on patient outcomes is crucial for policy decisions regarding emergency medical services.
data_description: The dataset includes 300 observations with columns: y (30-day mortality), x (hospital choice), z (ambulance diversion), and controls (patient demographics and health status). Ambulance diversion is used as an instrument to study the impact of hospital choice on mortality.
